personality_one_liner: A warm, editorial, and accessible local marketplace that feels like stepping into a cozy independent bookstore.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Use md to lg for component gaps, and xl or 2xl for page margins. Avoid cramped elements.

do's: Use solid white or surface layers for elevation as per editorial design.
dont's: No heavy blur or glass effects. Keep it matte and grounded.

screens.name: Auth / Onboarding
screens.purpose: Welcomes users with the cozy, indie-bookstore vibe and handles login.

states.error: Standard inline red error text for forms.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a cozy independent bookstore. A gradient scrim from transparent top to heavy surface at bottom. White overlay card holding the brand wordmark (in serif), tagline, and large Terracotta primary CTA. Clean form inputs below.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Primary marketplace feed showing local people and books.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking user rows and book tiles.
states.empty: Illustration of vintage books with 'No active exchangers nearby'.
states.error: Error message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: sticky search pill (Airbnb style) + segmented control (People / Books). If People: vertical list of wide cards. Each card shows avatar, name, distance, 'exchanging' sage dot, and a horizontal scroll of 3 mini book covers. If Books: 2-column masonry grid (Vinted style) of large book covers with crisp typography underneath.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Explore neighborhood-level book density and active swappers.

states.loading: Map loading state with central spinner.
states.error: Location permission error with a settings CTA.

screens.layout: Full-screen map. Custom markers (Sage bubbles) showing counts. Tapping a cluster triggers a Bottom Sheet (gorhom/bottom-sheet) revealing '342 people nearby' headline (serif), popular genre tags, and a 'Explore People' CTA. Map stays visible behind.

screens.name: My Books

states.empty: Illustration of empty shelves and a primary 'Add your first book' CTA.

screens.layout: Editorial header (serif title). Sticky horizontal filter chips (Available, Reserved, Swapped). 2-column grid of user's books. Each item has a cover, title, and a subtle status tag (Sage for Available, muted for Swapped).

screens.name: Swaps
screens.purpose: Manage active, incoming, and completed exchange requests.

states.empty: Graphic of two books swapping, 'No active swaps yet'.

screens.layout: List layout of conversations. Each row shows avatar, name, requested book cover thumbnail, and last message. Inside chat: Standard message bubbles + distinct 'Swap Action Cards' (e.g., 'Maria proposed a swap', 'Accept', 'Decline') embedded in the chat timeline.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: View and edit personal details and swap history.
screens.layout: Large rounded avatar, name, location, and rating badge. 'Currently exchanging' toggle switch prominently placed. Below: sections for 'Interested Genres' (chips), 'Languages', and 'Swap History'. Clean, list-based layout.

screens.name: Add Book Flow
screens.purpose: Quick, multi-step form to list a new book.
screens.layout: A full-screen modal or sheet. Step 1: Upload cover photo (large square target). Step 2: Title & Author (large text fields). Step 3: Condition (radio buttons). Sticky 'Next/Submit' button anchored to the keyboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design strictly for the '3 Editorial Mobile' personality: generous spacing, grounded matte surfaces (no heavy glassmorphism), and high typographic hierarchy.
Use Fraunces (serif) only for major headings (Auth, Screen Titles, Map Cluster Bottom Sheet headlines). Use DM Sans for everything else (body, labels, buttons).
The core background is Warm Paper (#F7F4EE). Use pure White (#FFFFFF) for cards and bottom sheets to create a crisp, editorial contrast.
Navigation: 5-item bottom tab bar. The middle item is a floating '+ Add Book' button. The active tab indicator should be Terracotta.
People Cards (Discover tab): Layout horizontally. Avatar, name, distance on top. A small 'exchanging' dot in Sage. Below that, a horizontal scrollview of 3 mini book covers they offer.
Book Grids: Use a 2-column masonry or grid layout (Vinted style) for books. The cover image is the hero; text underneath should be clean and readable.
For the Auth/Onboarding screen background, ensure a gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) is layered over the image so the white text and CTA pop perfectly.
Ensure all primary buttons (Terracotta) are pinned to the bottom of the screen with proper safe area padding, outside of the ScrollView.
Avoid any blue, purple, or indigo shades completely as per the no-tolerance color rule.
